headline: 00981A rises nearly 2%, attracts 3.1 billion; 00406A ex-dividend countdown draws 900 million; active ETFs in the spotlight
summary: Taiwan stock trading volume returned to the trillion level, with five ETFs entering the top ten by volume. The 00981A rose 1.93% while 00406A attracted 900 million and nears its ex-dividend date.
why: Trading volume and ETF flows are indicators of investor participation in the Taiwan Stock Exchange, which is dominated by large semiconductor companies.
